confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Jaipur prices. The Jaipur search returned crowdsourced cost-of-living figures for meals, beer and cappuccino. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. I set cocktail at about 2.5x beer and wine at about 2.5x beer, reflecting alcohol taxes and limited venue supply. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. The FX figure is the latest RBA observation found, dated 2026-11-18. Alcohol and accommodation are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other mid-sized Indian tourist cities such as Udaipur, Agra and Jodhpur, using Jaipur crowdsourced price indexes for food and drink.
